def hexd(af):
    return af/math.cos(math.pi/6)
def build(p):
    R=p.knob_d/2
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(p.knob_h).faces('<Z').chamfer(p.edge_chamfer)
    for i in range(int(p.lobe_n)):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.lobe_n
        rc=R+p.lobe_d/2-p.lobe_depth
        c=cq.Workplane('XY').center(rc*math.cos(a),rc*math.sin(a)).circle(p.lobe_d/2).extrude(p.knob_h)
        body=body.cut(c)
    depth=p.nut_h+p.nut_slack+p.lip_h
    z0=p.knob_h-depth
    pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0).polygon(6,hexd(p.nut_af+p.pocket_clear)).extrude(depth-p.lip_h)
    lip_af=p.nut_af-p.lip_interf
    lip=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.knob_h-p.lip_h-0.01).polygon(6,hexd(lip_af)).extrude(p.lip_h+0.02)
    cone=cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(lip_af/2,lip_af/2+p.lead_in,p.lead_in,pnt=cq.Vector(0,0,p.knob_h-p.lead_in),dir=cq.Vector(0,0,1)))
    hole=cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clear)/2).extrude(p.knob_h)
    return body.cut(pocket).cut(lip).cut(cone).cut(hole)

def hexd(af):
    return af/math.cos(math.pi/6)
def build(p):
    depth=p.nut_h+p.nut_slack+p.lip_h
    H=depth+p.coupon_floor
    W=p.coupon_pitch
    blk=cq.Workplane('XY').box(3*W,W,H,centered=(True,True,False))
    for k,i in enumerate((-1,0,1)):
        x=i*W
        interf=p.lip_interf+i*p.coupon_step
        lip_af=p.nut_af-interf
        pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.coupon_floor).center(x,0).polygon(6,hexd(p.nut_af+p.pocket_clear)).extrude(depth-p.lip_h)
        lip=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-p.lip_h-0.01).center(x,0).polygon(6,hexd(lip_af)).extrude(p.lip_h+0.02)
        cone=cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(lip_af/2,lip_af/2+p.lead_in,p.lead_in,pnt=cq.Vector(x,0,H-p.lead_in),dir=cq.Vector(0,0,1)))
        hole=cq.Workplane('XY').center(x,0).circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clear)/2).extrude(H)
        blk=blk.cut(pocket).cut(lip).cut(cone).cut(hole)
    return blk
